title: Seek control configuration
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input string, and let $d$ be a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and record states. For any seek control $q$, the associated seek-control configuration has the same tape data, head positions, and output as $d$, and its state is the pair consisting of no seek key and $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a finite Boolean input string
$d$ is a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes over Boolean symbols and record states
